correctness.rationale: For ξ with orthonormal U, exact Gaussian sectional integral is (2π)^(m/2) det(U^T exp(tH) U)^(-1/2). Set L=log det; Lʹ(0)=tr(PH), Lʺ(0)=tr(PH²)-tr(PHPH), P=UU^T. Haar rank-m projector second moments from invariance and tr(P)=tr(P²)=m yield E(tr(PH))²=2m(n-m)/(n(n-1)(n+2)) trH² and E Lʺ=m(n-m)/((n-1)(n+2)) trH² for traceless symmetric H. Differentiating exp(-qL/2) and averaging gives exact factor m(n-m)q(q-n)/(2n(n-1)(n+2)), with independent logarithmic q=0 formula. Independently checked invariant tensor contractions and polynomial identities for every 2<=n<=12, all 1<=m<n and representative q; infinite parameter theorem follows from symbolic projector argument, not finite tests. Sign definite for every nonzero H off q=n; q=n Hessian vanishes.
